summary: A specialist Toronto eyelid practice appears to lose consultations to zero counters, conflicting claims and a booking path that sends visitors away.

findings.problem: The three stat counters (Eyelid Surgeries, Surgical Procedures, Patients from Countries) appear to read 0+.
findings.cost: Zeros erase the proof that justifies a surgical fee.

findings.problem: The hero appears to claim 30,000+ surgeries and 20 years, while the body appears to say over 20,000 procedures and 15 years.
findings.cost: Two different numbers make a surgical claim look careless.
findings.fix: One verified set of numbers everywhere.

findings.problem: Several links appear to point to myshopify.com addresses instead of your own domain.
findings.cost: Visitors see a strange address at the moment they decide to trust you.
findings.fix: Every link on your own domain.

findings.problem: The BOOK NOW button appears to leave the page, and many testimonials appear to have no name or procedure.
findings.cost: Patients drop off at extra steps and unattributed praise is easy to doubt.
findings.fix: A short consultation form on the page and named reviews.

redesign: Clean links on your own domain.
On page consultation form and named reviews.
